source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of design patterns (PDF 25).

blocks.text: Design patterns software development ka fundamental (bunyadi) concept hain. Yeh un aam masloon ke aazmaye hue (proven) hal hain jo software banate waqt baar baar samne aate hain. Yeh blueprints (naqshe) ya templates (saanche) ki tarah hain jinhein mukhtalif design ke masle hal karne ke liye apne mutabiq dhaala ja sakta hai, is liye development ka process zyada efficient aur ek jaisa (consistent) ho jata hai.

blocks.title: Did You Know? (Kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Design patterns ka concept ek kitab ne mashhoor kiya: 'Design Patterns: Elements of Reusable Object-Oriented Software'. Is ke likhne wale Erich Gamma, Richard Helm, Ralph Johnson aur John Vlissides hain, jinhein “Gang of Four” (chaar logon ki toli) bhi kaha jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Design pattern ek jumle mein kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Software design ke kisi aam masle ka aazmaya hua hal, jo saanche (template) ki tarah baar baar istemal ho sakta hai.

items: Design patterns: aam design masloon ke aazmaye hue hal; blueprints ya templates ki tarah.
“Gang of Four” ki kitab ne in ko mashhoor kiya.
